Class VirtualViewRMI

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.RMI.Client.VirtualViewRMI
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, ViewInterface, Serializable, Remote
public class VirtualViewRMI extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualView, Remote
RMI implementation of the VirtualView interface. This class communicates with the client controller and updates the client view based on the game state.
See Also:
